description: This file contains utility functions for environment variable management, including capturing, restoring, and setting environment variables, as well as resolving paths on Windows systems.

methods.name: captureEnv
methods.description: Captures current environment variables specified by keys and provides a restore method.

methods.name: createPathResolutionEnv
methods.description: Creates a new environment object with resolved paths and specific OPENCLAW environment variables.

methods.name: withPathResolutionEnv
methods.description: Sets up a temporary environment with path resolution and executes a callback.

methods.name: captureFullEnv
methods.description: Captures the full current environment variables and provides a restore method.

methods.name: withEnv
methods.description: Temporarily applies environment variables for the duration of a function call.

methods.name: withEnvAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously applies environment variables for the duration of an async function call.
